title: Tafsir Ibn Kathir
description: Comprehensive study of Tafsir Ibn Kathir, one of the most authoritative classical tafsir works. Covering Quranic commentary with authentic hadith explanations from the Salaf.
short_description: Classical Quranic commentary with authentic hadith

modules.title: Introduction to Tafsir Ibn Kathir
modules.description: Foundational concepts of Tafsir Ibn Kathir methodology and approach to Quranic commentary.

lessons.title: Overview of Tafsir Ibn Kathir
lessons.content: Introduction to the methodology of Imaam Ibn Kathir (رحمه الله) in Quranic exegesis, including his reliance on Quran解释Quran, authentic Sunnah, and statements of the Salaf.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Al-Fatihah
lessons.content: Detailed commentary on Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening), the greatest Surah of the Quran, with explanation of its virtues and meanings.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Al-Baqarah (Part 1)
lessons.content: Beginning of the commentary on Surah Al-Baqah (The Cow), the longest Surah in the Quran, with lessons from the stories of Bani Isra'il.

modules.title: Stories of the Prophets
modules.description: Tafsir sections covering the narratives of the Anbiya (prophets) and their nations.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Aal-e-Imran
lessons.content: Commentary on Surah Aal-e-Imran (The Family of Imran) discussing the stories of Maryam (Mary), Isa (Jesus), and the People of the Book.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah An-Nisa
lessons.content: Explanation of Surah An-Nisa (The Women) covering rulings on marriage, inheritance, and social justice in Islam.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Al-Ma'idah
lessons.content: Commentary on Surah Al-Ma'idah (The Table Spread) including laws of halal and haram, and the covenant of the prophets.

modules.title: Themes and Lessons from the Quran
modules.description: Exploring major themes and spiritual lessons derived from various Surahs of the Quran.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Al-An'am
lessons.content: Explanation of Surah Al-An'am (The Cattle) focusing on tawheed (monotheism) and refutation of shirk (polytheism).

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Al-A'raf
lessons.content: Commentary on Surah Al-A'raf (The Heights) covering stories of Nuh (Noon), Hud, Salih, and other prophets.

lessons.title: Tafsir of Surah Al-Anfal
lessons.content: Explanation of Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War) discussing the Battle of Badr and guidelines for Muslim conduct in conflict.
